make.table: Planned work orders and subcontract orders
make.search: Search style, colour, order, line or workshop

empty.title: No work orders to propose

empty.noRun: No plan has been run for this site yet.

held.noDemand: It makes no order line (stock): a work order is made from order lines.
held.noRevision: Its style has no released revision to make it to.
held.other: It cannot be made real now: open the style or the order to see why.
held.noRight: Your role cannot make planned orders real or change them.
held.noConvert: Your role cannot make planned orders real (planning.planned.convert).
held.noWorkOrders: Making it real makes a work order: your role cannot (workorders.manage).
held.noSubcontract: Making it real releases the work order and drafts the subcontract order: your role cannot (workorders.release, purchasing.subcontract.manage).
held.noMake: None of the ticked rows is a planned work order that can be made real.
held.noSubcontractRow: None of the ticked rows is a planned subcontract order that can be made real.
held.noneToMove: None of the ticked rows can be moved.
held.tooMany: Move at most 100 at a time.
held.firm: It is firm: plan it again first to change its dates.
held.noFirm: Your role cannot make planned orders firm (planning.firm).
held.noEdit: Your role cannot change planned orders (planning.planned.edit).
held.noActions: Your role cannot decide action messages (planning.actions.manage).
held.noneOpen: None of the ticked messages is open.
held.notLatest: A newer plan replaced these messages: read the page again.

notice.firmed: {label} is firm: the next runs keep it as it is.
notice.unfirmed: {label} is planned again by the next run.
notice.datesSaved: The dates of {label} are saved and kept by the next runs.
notice.resetNextRun: {field} is given back to the plan: the next run writes it.

problem.read: Couldn't read it. Try again in a moment.
problem.offline: No answer from the server: check the connection.
problem.gone: It is not there any more: read the page again.
problem.signedOut: You were signed out: sign in again.
problem.write: It was not saved. Try again.
problem.changed: Someone changed it meanwhile: it was read again, check it and try again.
problem.invalid: The change was refused: check the values.
problem.unknown: No answer: it may or may not have been saved. Read the page again.

summary.MAKE: Each becomes a DRAFT work order with its sizes; nothing is released or sent.
summary.SUBCONTRACT: Each makes its work order, releases it and drafts the subcontract order at the workshop; nothing is sent to the workshop.

next.MAKE: Draft work order · revision {revision} · {pieces} pieces · due {due}

convert.heldChecks_one: {count} check stops it: open the style or the work order to see it.
convert.heldChecks_other: {count} checks stop it: open the style or the work order to see them.
convert.noneReady: None of these can be made real now.

done.SUBCONTRACT: Work order {workOrder} released · subcontract order {order} drafted

error.conflict: Changed since it was read: not made
error.invalid_state: Its state no longer allows it: not made
error.validation_failed: A check refused it: not made
error.forbidden: Not allowed for your role: not made

shift.summary: Start, due and the kit move together; every moved date is kept by the next runs.
shift.hint: A negative number brings them forward. Nothing moves before today.
shift.days: Type a whole number of days, not 0, at most 366.
shift.refused: The move was refused: check the days.

decide.bodyDone: Done means you made the change on the order (a moved date, a new quantity, a cancelled line).
decide.bodyIgnore: Ignored messages are not raised again by the next runs for the same order and change.
decide.noteHintIgnore: Optional: why it stays as it is.
decide.tooLong: The note is at most 2000 characters.

msg.title: Action messages on existing orders
msg.hint: What the latest plan asks you to change on orders that exist already.
msg.explain: The plan never changes an existing order by itself: change the order, then mark the message done.

empty.title: No action message
empty.body: Every existing order fits the latest plan.
empty.noRun: No plan has been run for this site yet.

msg.never: Done and Ignore only record your decision: the order itself is changed on its own page.
msg.notice_one: {count} action message on an existing order waits for a decision.
msg.notice_other: {count} action messages on existing orders wait for a decision.

log.open: Inputs and warnings of the run of {time}
log.title: The run of {time} ({trigger})
log.notRecorded: This run is older than the run log: its inputs were not recorded.

profile.title: Projected stock — {material}
profile.notFound: This material is not in the plan any more.
profile.asOf: The plan computed now ({time}) at {site}, {weeks} weeks from this week.
profile.firstShort: Short from {week}: the orders need more than stock and receipts bring.
profile.chartLabel: Projected balance of {material} per week, with the safety stock

profile.noLots: The plan places no new order for this material.
profile.earliest: A new order placed today arrives {arrival} and can be used {usable} ({lead} days lead time, {delay} days to use).
profile.earliestNoLead: A new order placed today arrives {arrival} and can be used {usable} (no lead time on record).
profile.noDelays: No demand is late for this material.

profile.delay_other: line {line} needs it {need}: usable {earliest} at the earliest, {count} days late ({source})

lotHint.LOT_FOR_LOT: Each order brings exactly what is short.
lotHint.FIXED: Each order brings the fixed lot, as many lots as the need takes.
lotHint.MIN_MAX: Each order keeps the row's order limits: at least the minimum, in steps of the multiple, at most the maximum.
lotHint.PERIOD: One order brings the need of a number of days; the next period is the next order.

items.minMaxLimits: This row's limits: at least {min}, in steps of {step}, at most {max} {unit}.
items.minMaxNone: This row has no order limits yet: each order is exactly the need (as lot for lot).

levelHint.SITE: Planned work orders follow the site's size-run rule (one grid, or its size groups).
levelHint.STYLE: One planned work order per colourway with its sizes in one grid (a planned work order makes one colourway).
levelHint.STYLE_COLOUR: The colourway's sizes in one grid, whatever the site's size groups.
levelHint.SKU: Each size is a planned work order of its own.

held.material: A material is planned per colour: only a finished garment or a component is planned by style, colour or size.
held.items: Your role cannot change item parameters (planning.items.manage).
held.strategy: How a garment is planned needs planning.strategy.manage too (planner, production manager).
held.settings: Your role cannot change the site's planning settings (planning.settings.manage).

problem.fixedNeeded: A fixed lot needs its quantity: how much each order brings.
problem.fixedOnly: A fixed lot belongs to fixed lot sizing.
problem.fixedQty: The fixed lot is a quantity above 0 with at most four decimals.
problem.periodNeeded: A period needs its days: the days of need one order brings.
problem.periodOnly: A period belongs to period lot sizing.
problem.planLevel: Pick style, style and colour, each size, or the site's rule.
problem.scrap: Scrap is a percent from 0 to under 100, at most two decimals (5 or 2.5).
problem.yield: Yield is a percent above 0 and at most 100, at most two decimals (92 or 87.5).
problem.delay: The days between arrival and use are {min} to {max}.
problem.lotSizing: Pick how the orders are sized.
problem.write: It was not saved. Try again.
problem.conflict: Someone changed it meanwhile: it was read again, check it and try again.
problem.unknown: No answer: it may or may not have been saved. Read the page again.

words.lotFinished: Kept for the finished garment: the plan sizes material orders only (a planned work order makes the ordered pieces).
words.FIXED: Each order brings {quantity} {unit}, as many as the need takes.
words.PERIOD_one: One order brings the need of {count} day.
words.PERIOD_other: One order brings the need of {count} days.
words.MIN_MAX: Each order is at least {min}, in steps of {step}, at most {max} {unit}; above the maximum the need is split.
words.MIN_MAX_none: No order limits on this row: each order is exactly the need.
words.onlyOrders: Read only while the item is planned from its orders.

level.SKU: Each size is a planned work order of its own.
level.STYLE_COLOUR: The colourway's sizes are planned in one grid, whatever the site's size groups.
level.STYLE: Planned as style and colour: a planned work order makes one colourway.

words.levelComponent: Kept for the component: a component is planned per colour as a part to make (planned work orders of components are not made yet).
words.scrapYield: The need is multiplied by {factor}, on top of the bill's wastage.
words.scrapYieldFinished: Every material of this size is multiplied by {factor}, on top of the bill's wastage.
words.delay_one: {count} day between arrival and use: a supply can be used that many days after it arrives.
words.delay_other: {count} days between arrival and use: a supply can be used that many days after it arrives.

items.cleared: Cleared because the lot sizing changed: {fields}.

sizeRun.title: Size run of planned work orders
sizeRun.oneGrid: One grid per colourway: every size of an order's colourway in one planned work order.

sizeRun.dialogTitle: Size run of planned work orders
sizeRun.rule: How a size run is split
sizeRun.hintONE_GRID: Every size of a colourway in one planned work order.
sizeRun.hintSIZE_GROUPS: A planned work order per group of sizes; a size in no group is a group of its own.
sizeRun.groupsHint: Sizes split by commas, for example: 44, 46, 48. 2 to 20 groups; a size in one group only.
sizeRun.clears: One grid clears the size groups.
sizeRun.failed: Couldn't read the site's size run.
sizeRun.savedOne: Planned work orders are made in one grid per colourway.
sizeRun.savedGroups_one: Planned work orders are split into {count} size group.
sizeRun.savedGroups_other: Planned work orders are split into {count} size groups.

problem.twice: Size {size} is in two groups: a size is in one group only.
problem.codes: A group lists {min} to {max} sizes of 1 to {code} characters, without spaces.
problem.refused: The size groups were refused: check them.
